episodes.title: Carn-Evil
episodes.summary: Cuphead convinces Mugman they should ditch their chores and head to the carnival, unaware it's a front to collect souls.

episodes.title: Baby Bottle
episodes.summary: The brothers take care of a baby left at their front door. But with Elder Kettle gone and a strict warning to be good, it's harder than they imagined.

episodes.title: Ribby and Croaks
episodes.summary: A squabbling Mugman and Cuphead sneak into a club to grab some ice cream after the boxing champs who own it steal their money.

episodes.title: Handle with Care
episodes.summary: After Mugman's handle breaks off, the brothers visit a greedy shopkeeper and get creative while on the hunt for glue.

episodes.title: Roll the Dice
episodes.summary: All bets are off when Cuphead takes over Inkwell Isle's No. 1 game show, much to the annoyance of its devious host King Dice and his devilish boss.

episodes.title: Ghosts Aint Real!
episodes.summary: A spooky bunch of ghosts treat Cuphead and Mugman to a night of chills and thrills after trapping them inside a creepy graveyard.

episodes.title: Root Packed
episodes.summary: Cuphead and Mugman have to defend Elder Kettle's precious vegetable garden after a rotten gang turns their yard into a party.

episodes.title: Sweater Off Dead
episodes.summary: Mugman knits a special sweater to keep Cuphead's soul safe. Meanwhile, in the underworld, the Devil is throwing a party.

episodes.title: Sweater Luck Next Time
episodes.summary: The Devil follows the brothers day after day, waiting for Cuphead to take off his sweater so he can collect his soul before Stickler finds out.

episodes.title: Dangerous Mugman
episodes.summary: Cuphead and a cowardly Mugman test their courage after Porkrind sends them on a dangerous errand that quickly gets out of hand.

episodes.title: Dirt Nap
episodes.summary: Elder Kettle overhears strange conversations between Cuphead and Mugman, then worries that the boys have menacing plans for him.

episodes.title: In Charm's Way
episodes.summary: Trouble follows the brothers when Cuphead and Mugman get in over their heads upon meeting a free-spirited, street-smart new friend.

episodes.title: Jail-broken
episodes.summary: Cuphead and Mugman are in the slammer after breaking into the cookie factory. Prison's scary — but now they can't decide whether to bust out or stay in!

episodes.title: Charmed and Dangerous
episodes.summary: Trouble comes a-knockin' when Ms. Chalice turns up on Elder Kettle's doorstep and turns on the charm. The question is: Can she be trusted?

episodes.title: A High Seas Adventure!
episodes.summary: The boys think they're just "playing" pirate until they actually drift out to sea and get roped into a mission to reunite a captain and his sweetheart.

episodes.title: Another Brother
episodes.summary: After an argument with Mugman, Cuphead goes looking for another brother. But his reckless new sibling isn't all he's cracked up to be.

episodes.title: Sweet Temptation
episodes.summary: Cuphead's self-control is put to the test when he discovers a sugary dreamland where he can eat all the sweets he wants... with a catch.

episodes.title: The I Scream Man
episodes.summary: All Mugman wants is a little peace and quiet while Cuphead and Elder Kettle are away. Enter the ice cream man — and his jaunty truck's maddening jingle.

episodes.title: Piano Lesson
episodes.summary: Mugman gets dangerously jealous when his snooty piano teacher taps Cuphead to compete for a $10,000 musical prize instead of him.

episodes.title: Release the Demons!
episodes.summary: Steaming mad and ready for revenge, the Devil summons his finest demons and sends them above ground on a mission to recapture Cuphead's soul.

episodes.title: Dead Broke
episodes.summary: Ms. Chalice and the boys craft a perfect spooky scam: making money as ghost removers! But things get real when they pick a house that's already haunted.

episodes.title: Rat's All, Folks!
episodes.summary: A crafty rat claims ownership of Elder Kettle's cottage and all of its contents after a careless Cuphead and Mugman leave the door open.

episodes.title: Say Cheese!
episodes.summary: Elder Kettle wants to snap a family portrait of him and his boys — and, boy, does he get it! Just not in the picture-perfect setting he was expecting.

episodes.title: Lost in the Woods
episodes.summary: Winter's coming and there's lots of work to do, but Cuphead doesn't want to do any of it. Forget chopping wood — he'd rather launch rockets into the sky!

episodes.title: The Devil's Pitchfork
episodes.summary: Cuphead and Mugman are giddy with power when they get their hands on the Devil's pitchfork and make fiery mischief all over town.

episodes.title: The Devil's Revenge!
episodes.summary: Without Mugman, Cuphead doesen`t know what to do with himself. Can he strike a deal with the Devil to save his beloved brother and bring him home?

episodes.title: Don't Answer the Door
episodes.summary: Knock, knock! Danger`s at the door when Elder Kettle goes out to get his mustache waxed, leaving a bumbling Cuphead and Mugman home alone.

episodes.title: Cupstaged
episodes.summary: Sally Stageplay`s holding auditions for an exciting new space opera. By Cuphead, Mugman and the Devil all want the same role: the lead.

episodes.title: Roadkill
episodes.summary: After hitting the Devil with his car, Elder Kettle takes him in, mistaking him for a humble house cat he affectionately calls "Mrs. Meow Meow."

episodes.title: Holiday Tree-dition
episodes.summary: With Christmas fast approaching, Elder Kettle sends the boys on an important errand: to pick out the perfect tree.

episodes.title: A Very Devil Christmas
episodes.summary: Christmas brings out the worst in the Devil, who`s notoriously naughty... until he schemes to get himself onto Santa`s nice list.

episodes.title: Special Delivery
episodes.summary: After breaking Porkrind`s window, Cuphead, Mugman and Ms. Chalice must work off the debt by delivering a mysterious package to Ribby and Croaks.

episodes.title: Down and Out... with King Dice!
episodes.summary: King Dice - the Devil`s onetime No. 1 - is out of the spotlight. But Cuphead of all people wants to be his manager and help him make a comeback.

episodes.title: Joy Ride
episodes.summary: It`s time for a day of fun with Elder Kettle... or is it? With an assist from Ms. Chalice, Cuphead and Mugman are scaring up shenanigans all over town!

episodes.title: Dance with Danger
episodes.summary: A fateful flashback reveals what Ms. Chalice`s life was like before she met Cuphead and Mugman.

episodes.title: The Devil and Ms. Chalice
episodes.summary: An epic dance contest morphs into a high-stakes game of winners and losers, with more that one soul on the line. How will it all end? Hilariously.
